purpose: The dot's poses, one for each state; desktop/src/ui/pose.rs draws them.

prompts.ready: Reuses the existing approved silhouette; see ../generation.txt
prompts.cold:
Use case: logo-brand. Draw ONE ultra-minimal bold BLACK SILHOUETTE logo of the SAME Saambha mascot as the input reference, in a new pose. SOLID BLACK #000000 shapes on a SOLID WHITE #FFFFFF background; completely opaque image, pure two colors only. This is clean vector-logo geometry, no gradients, no lighting, no shading, no texture, no transparency, no grain, no speckles, no fine outlines. Maintain the reference identity: sweeping wavy hair in a few large lobes, curved white cutout cloth headband, large entirely blank WHITE face bounded by BLACK hair and BLACK connected moustache and short pointed beard; V-neck kurta bust with just FOUR broad diagonal white cartridge cutouts on viewer-right chest. The face is blank: no eyes, eyebrows, nose or rendered features. Stencil-simple, big chunky shapes and generous white gaps for a 40px app dot. Character has a huge head and short chest like reference, compact round-bottom bust, no long torso. Square canvas, full pose centered inside generous 12% white margins, nothing cropped. No text, letters, pictograms, badges, symbols or decorations. SAME character and style, only the gesture changes.
RESTING / UNAVAILABLE POSE: the head is visibly BOWED DOWN toward viewer-left in a three-quarter angle. Chin almost touches chest; crown of wavy hair leans strongly forward, forehead/headband tilts at about 30 degrees, white face opening is foreshortened and small. Shoulders stay horizontal and relaxed, arms down. The change must be much stronger than simply rotating the upright logo: show a sleeping/dormant bowed head, without eyes, facial features, sleepy symbols or text. Preserve the headband, hair silhouette, beard and four chest cutouts.

The forehead-to-nose-to-mouth edge is a single clean profile contour; use a LARGE SIMPLE WHITE wedge opening between upper moustache and lower beard/chin, so it unmistakably reads as speaking at 40px. posing: Each traced pose is then bent by hand so it has a line of action: the whole bust sways about the centre of its base arc, the head tilts about the neck, and one shoulder lifts.
